Name: Zichri, Father of Elishaphat
Summary: Zichri was the father of Elishaphat, a captain of hundreds in Jehoiada's covenant.
KeyStory: Zichri is named only as the father of Elishaphat the son of Zichri.
LifeLesson: Three men named Zichri appear in 2 Chronicles; this one is known only as Elishaphat's father.
